items.comment: Accurate: verified `scala.Function1` defines `override def toString(): String = "<function1>"` and `AbstractFunction1` adds no override, so the inherited default really is `<function1>`, and the object is genuinely the companion of the `ScalaReflectionException` case class, so 'name of this companion object' is correct. Minor precision nit: the toString is inherited via the immediate supertype `AbstractFunction1`, which itself just passes through `Function1`'s implementation — attributing it directly to `[[scala.Function1]]` is defensible but slightly glosses over the intermediate class. Not worth blocking on.
